items.title: 53566_Benjamin F.
items.q: Hardie and Porter and all of them went to Mosby when he had the Blue Blowers.

ctx.x: And Buster Wilson, piano; Jesse Smith, tenor sax; Ben Borders, drums; Howard Patrick, banjo; James Porter, trumpet, and Ashford Hardie, trombone.
Yeah. Most of that band was Mosby's band after ...Hardie and Porter and all of them went to Mosby when he had the Blue Blowers.
